# Required List Length Attribute

Displays an error when the array or list length is outside the required range.

> [!NOTE]
> This attribute only reports errors. It does not change the collection size or disable Add/Remove in the Inspector.

[!code-csharp[](../../../../tests/Alchemy.Tests/Assets/Alchemy.Tests.EditorUI/Documentation/RequiredListLengthTest.cs#document)]

| Parameter | Description |
| - | - |
| length | Exact number of elements required. |
| min | Minimum number of elements, or `null` for no minimum. |
| max | Maximum number of elements, or `null` for no maximum. |
